name: Tiehong (铁红): iron-oxide red in tung oil over a 地仗 ground

diffuseAlbedo.note: A dull iron-oxide red, the gilder's bole's red; no measured colour was read: a first value read from trade and museum photographs of the named material.

refractiveIndex.source: Tung oil dries to a film of index about 1.52 (a polymerised drying oil, as linseed's 1.48 to 1.52)
refractiveIndex.note: The binder the pigment is bound in; the pigment sets the colour.

porosity.note: A first open porosity for the material; no measurement was read.

wettingDepth.note: The depth whose pores govern the face's look when wet.

grain.note: The finest structure the face shows.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across one face.
